techniques.mechanic: Tori hooks a foot behind uke's heel from the outside and pins it to the mat, then drives their weight straight into uke's chest. With the foot anchored and unable to step back, uke topples backward over their own trapped leg.
techniques.analogy: One boot is sunk to the ankle in deep mud when a friend gives you a playful shove on the chest. The rescue step backward never comes, the boot won't budge, so you tip straight over it like a fence post, flat onto your back.
techniques.why_it_maps: The mud is tori's hooking foot pinning the heel to the ground: with the support anchored, the chest-high push has nothing to do but rotate you straight over backward.
techniques.image_prompt: A muddy field where one person's boot is sunk deep in the mud, leg anchored, while a friend's outstretched hand has just shoved their chest; the stuck person is tipping straight backward like a felled post, the anchored leg still upright in the mud, arms flailing. Side view emphasizing the trapped boot as the fixed point of the fall.

techniques.mechanic: Tori reaches over or under uke's arm and grabs the belt like a handle, hauls uke up onto the hip with that grip ('tsuri' means fishing) and rotates them over the hip to the mat.
techniques.analogy_name: Hauling the big fish over the rail
techniques.analogy: A fisherman has hooked a huge fish and heaves it up out of the water on a taut line. At the top of the pull the fish swings up and over the boat's rail, pivoting on the gunwale and flopping down onto the deck on the other side.
techniques.why_it_maps: The fishing line is the belt grip (a single handle doing all the lifting) and the boat rail is tori's hip: hoist the load up on the handle, let it pivot over the rail, and it lands on the far side.
techniques.image_prompt: A small fishing boat on calm water: a fisherman leans back hauling a taut fishing line with both hands, and an enormous fish is caught mid-air at the top of the arc, swinging up and over the boat's side rail, about to flop onto the deck. The fish's body curves over the rail like a load pivoting on a fulcrum. Side view showing the line, the rail contact point, and the fish's arc.

techniques.mechanic: A sacrifice throw: tori deliberately falls onto their own side, sliding an extended leg against the outside of uke's feet. Tori's falling body weight, transmitted through the grips, drags uke sideways over their own blocked feet.
techniques.analogy: Two friends stand holding wrists at the edge of a pool. One suddenly lets themselves fall in, and the raised pool edge catches the other friend's feet while the falling friend's whole weight yanks them sideways, so they pitch helplessly over the coping and into the water too.
techniques.why_it_maps: The falling friend is tori's sacrificed body weight doing the pulling, and the raised pool edge is tori's extended leg blocking uke's feet: anchored feet plus a great weight dropping beside you equals a sideways crash.
techniques.image_prompt: A backyard swimming pool with a raised stone edge: one person is mid-fall into the water, back-first with a splash beginning, still gripping the wrist of a second person on the deck. The second person's feet are caught against the raised pool edge and their body is tipping sideways over it, off balance, about to be pulled in. Side-on composition showing the edge blocking the feet and the falling body's weight dragging through the joined arms.

techniques.mechanic: Tori turns in and holds an extended leg as a rigid horizontal bar across the front of uke's knees, then pulls uke's upper body forward and around. Uke's legs stop at the bar while their body keeps traveling, so they wheel around the leg like a wheel around an axle.
techniques.analogy_name: Flipping over the low chain fence
techniques.analogy: A kid sprints across a park and doesn't see the knee-high chain slung between two posts. The chain stops their shins cold, their upper body keeps going, and they somersault clean over it, feet flying up over their head.
techniques.why_it_maps: The taut chain is tori's extended leg, a fixed bar at knee height, and the runner's own momentum is tori's pull: body rotates over the bar because the legs are stopped and the torso isn't.
techniques.image_prompt: A park path with two short posts and a taut chain strung between them at knee height: a running child has just hit the chain with their shins and is caught mid-somersault directly above it, body inverted, legs swinging up and over their head, sneakers in the air. Side view with the chain clearly the pivot point of the flip.

techniques.mechanic: Tori tucks in close with one bent, springy leg pressed across uke's thighs and the hip loaded under uke. Then the leg snaps straight with a hop ('hane' means spring), bouncing uke up off the coiled leg and over.
techniques.analogy: A kid sits on the low end of a seesaw when a big kid leaps onto the high end. The plank springs up beneath them and they're launched, bounced up off the board and forward through the air in a somersault.
techniques.why_it_maps: The plank snapping upward under the kid's body is tori's coiled leg springing straight: a loaded spring beneath the hips that suddenly releases and bounces the whole body up and over.
techniques.image_prompt: A playground seesaw at the instant of launch: a large kid has just slammed down on one end, the plank is kicked steeply upward, and a small kid is flying off the rising end — airborne above the board, tipping into a forward somersault, sneakers over head. Side view showing the plank's spring and the arc of flight.

techniques.mechanic: Tori lifts and draws uke upward-forward with both grips, holding uke's weight almost suspended, while sweeping uke's advancing foot sideways before it can land and take weight. The feet fly out from under a body that's being held up from above.
techniques.analogy: A marionette dangles from its strings, feet just brushing the stage. A broom whisks across the floor and sweeps its little wooden feet sideways, and the puppet's legs sail out from under it while its body, still hanging from the strings, swings and twists in the air.
techniques.why_it_maps: The strings are tori's lifting 'tsurikomi' pull (the support comes from above, so the feet are light), and the broom is the sweeping leg: with weight held up top, one sideways brush takes the feet completely away.
techniques.image_prompt: A puppet theater stage: a wooden marionette suspended from visible strings held by a hand above, its feet swept sideways off the floor by a household broom pushed by another hand entering from the side. The puppet's legs trail horizontally in the direction of the broom stroke while its torso hangs and tilts from the taut strings. Composition shows strings taut above and both feet airborne.

techniques.mechanic: As uke pushes forward, tori drops straight onto their own back, plants a foot on uke's belly, and uses uke's charging momentum plus the extending leg to sling them overhead in a full circle ('tomoe' is a swirling comma shape).
techniques.analogy: A parent lies back on the grass playing airplane: foot on the kid's tummy, hands in hands. But this time the leg extends with a whoosh and the kid actually launches, soaring upside down clear over the parent's head, a full loop in the air.
techniques.why_it_maps: It is the same machine: the parent's planted foot is tori's launching leg, the held hands are the grips steering the circle, and the kid's forward lean is uke's momentum being redirected overhead.
techniques.image_prompt: A sunny backyard lawn: a parent lies flat on their back with one leg extended straight up, foot planted on a child's belly, hands gripping the child's hands. The child is airborne and inverted, mid-arc directly overhead, hair and shirt tumbling, following a circular flight path over the parent's head. Side view capturing the full circle of the trajectory.

techniques.mechanic: Tori drops low, pulls uke's arm so their body folds across tori's shoulders, draped like a load in a fireman's carry, then stands and wheels uke across the shoulders, rolling them off the far side to the mat.
techniques.analogy: A farmer squats, hoists a huge sack of grain across the shoulders, and carries it balanced behind the neck. At the wagon, one heave, and the sack rolls end over end across the shoulders and tumbles off the far side.
techniques.why_it_maps: The shoulders are the axle in both: a long load draped across them is lifted from one side and wheeled over to drop off the other, which is exactly what 'shoulder wheel' means.
techniques.image_prompt: A farmyard beside a wooden wagon: a farmer bent at the knees with an enormous full grain sack draped across the back of their shoulders, caught at the moment of heaving it over — the sack tipping past the far shoulder, rolling end over end, about to tumble off and down. Side view showing the shoulders as the pivot point of the sack's rotation.
